question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Feeble
solution:
The correct answer is **"strong" **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word:
 
 
• **Feeble**- weak, lacking in power.

 
 
• **Example**- My grandmother is feeble.
 
 
 
 
 
• look at the meanings of the words in the options:
 
 
• **Frail**- weak.
 
• **Soft**- which can be bent easily, weak.
 
• **Strong**- sturdy, opposite of weak.
 
• **Weak**- lacking in power.
 
 
 
• By considering the options, we can clearly see that **feeble** is the opposite of strong.
 
• Hence, the right answer is: *strong.*
